issues.note: The front asks for TWO items but the corpus lists THREE besides inconsistent output format, so the card has no single correct answer. A learner answering 'multi-issue request handling' would be marked wrong for giving a corpus-correct answer.

suggested.text: Besides inconsistent output format, name the three decisions few-shot examples are the documented first-choice fix for.

suggested_back.text: Ambiguous tool selection, multi-issue request handling, and escalation calibration.
